modules.name: CSharpier
modules.description: Opinionated C# and XML formatter (https://csharpier.com). Format Document: Shift+Alt+F.
modules.author: ByteForge

modules.name: .NET Project Files
modules.description: Adds the files every .NET repo wants: .gitignore, .editorconfig (C# style and naming rules), Directory.Build.props, global.json (pinned to your SDK) and a .gitattributes. "Files: Add …" in the command palette; existing files are never overwritten.
modules.author: ByteForge

modules.name: Focus Timer
modules.description: A Pomodoro timer in the status bar: 25 minutes of focus, 5 minutes of break (every 4th: 15). Click it to start, pause or resume; a desktop notification (notify-send) says when time's up.
modules.author: ByteForge

modules.name: GUID Generator
modules.description: Inserts a new GUID at the cursor: "GUID: Insert New GUID" (Ctrl+Alt+G), plus uppercase, braced ({…}) and C# (new Guid("…")) variants.
modules.author: ByteForge

modules.name: JSON Formatter
modules.description: Formats .json files (appsettings.json, launchSettings.json, global.json, …) with Format Document. Keeps comments and trailing commas out of the way: files with comments are left as they are.
modules.author: ByteForge

modules.name: TODO Finder
modules.description: Finds TODO, FIXME, HACK and BUG comments in the workspace. "TODOs: List All" prints them with clickable locations; the count stays in the status bar and updates when you save.
modules.author: ByteForge
